# dsh-mlir-toolchain
**MLIR toolchain tools for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** — probe, run, TableGen and parse-check MLIR with
out shell quotes or `ENOENT` surprises.
English | 简体中文
This is a DSH plugin. It turns a `toolchain.json` (generated by your MLIR build script) into four mo
del-facing tools backed by the host subprocess service:
| Tool | What it does |
| `mlir_probe` | Reads `toolchain.json`, probes every binary **in parallel** with `--version`, and r
eports `ok`, missing vs. failing tools, version mismatches and the TableGen include directories that

would be used |
| `mlir_run` | Runs `mlir-opt`, `mlir-translate`, `mlir-tblgen`, `mlir-runner`, `ml
ir-reduce`, `llc`, `clang`, `filecheck`, `llvm-config` or `llvm-objdump` with an argv array (no shel

l) |
| `mlir_tblgen` | `-gen-*` code generation with automatic `mlir/IR/OpBase.td` discovery, 35 nam

ed kinds, raw flag passthrough and auto-created output directories |
| `mlir_parse_check` | Parses/v
erifies MLIR with `mlir-opt`, optionally running a pass pipeline, and returns structured errors/warn
with `mlir-opt`, optionally running a pass pipeline, and returns structured errors/warnings/notes |
Nothing is executed through a shell, no binaries are looked up on `PATH`, and the plugin has **zero
runtime dependencies**.
## Requirements

- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`
- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0-0`
- LLVM/MLIR binaries. De
velopment and CI checks were done against LLVM 23.1.4, but any recent release that provides `mlir-op

t`, `mlir-translate`, `mlir-tblgen` and `llc` should work.
- `mlir-tblgen` additionally needs MLIR's
TableGen headers (`mlir/IR/OpBase.td`) — from a source checkout or an installed `mlir/include`.
A `toolchain.json` is recommended. Its shape (extra fields are ignored):

Recognised `llvm.tools` keys: `mlirOpt`, `mlirTranslate`, `mlirTblgen`, `mlirRunner`, `mlirReduce`,
`llc`, `opt`, `clang`, `llvmConfig`, `llvmObjdump`, `cmake`, `ninja`, `filecheck`.

its bundled `cordis.patch.yml`. Server-side plugins hot-reload — the four tools appear immediately.

> If you are trying the plugin inside a sandboxed session (DSH `workspace-write`), the profile direc
tory may live outside the workspace. Install it from a normal terminal or grant the operation the pe
rmission it asks for.
## Configuration
Zero configuration works when `toolchain.json` sits next to the plugin directory (the common `mlir-l
ang/dsh-mlir-toolchain` + `mlir-lang/toolchain.json` layout), inside it, in the session cwd, or in `
<cwd>/mlir-lang/`. Discovery runs once at plugin load and again per call when no path was found — so
a session opened in a different directory still picks it up.
Precedence: `config.toolchainPath` / `MLIR_TOOLCHAIN_JSON` > auto-discovery.
To point at a specific file (or override individual binaries):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Option | Default | Meaning |

| `toolchainPath` | auto | Absolute path to `toolchain.json` |
| `includeDirs` | `[]` | Extra TableG

en include roots |
| `timeoutMs` | `120000` | Per-call timeout (clamped to 1s–10min) |
| `maxOutputB

ytes` | `1048576` | stdout/stderr bytes returned per stream (clamped to 4 KiB–8 MiB) |
| `graceMs` |

`5000` | Grace period before a timed-out process is killed |
| `logKeep` | `100` | Keep only the ne
west N files in `.mlir-logs/` |
Environment variables: `MLIR_TOOLCHAIN_JSON` (path to `toolchain.json`), `MLIR_INCLUDE_DIR` (TableGe
n include roots, `;`/`:` separated).
## Tools
### `mlir_probe`
Probes every tool referenced by the configuration, in parallel.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`missing` means the file does not exist; `failed` means it exists but `--version` failed. TableGen i
nclude directories are reported here so you can spot a broken `-I` before generating code.
### `mlir_run`
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Returns `{ ok, exitCode, timedOut, durationMs, stdout, stderr, truncated, logPath, hint }`. `inputTe
xt` is written to a temporary `.mlir` file and appended as the last argument; `inputPath` is resolve
d against the session cwd. Full output is written to `.mlir-logs/` when it exceeds `maxOutputBytes`,
and `hint` points at the log.
### `mlir_tblgen`
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- `kind` accepts named kinds (`op-decls`, `op-defs`, `op-doc`, `op-interface-decls/defs/docs`, `dial
ect-decls/defs/doc`, `dialect-interface-decls`, `typedef-decls/defs/doc`, `attrdef-decls/defs/doc`,
`enum-decls/defs/doc`, `attr-constraint-decls/defs`, `type-constraint-decls/defs`, `rewriters`, `pas
s-decls`, `pass-doc`, `pass-capi-header`, `pass-capi-impl`, `bytecode`, `directive-decl`, `llvmir-co
nversions`, `enum-from/to-llvmir-conversions`, `op-from-llvmir-conversions`, `convertible-llvmir-int
rinsics`, `python-op-bindings`, `python-enum-bindings`, …) or a raw `gen:<name>` / `-gen-<name>` fla

g.
- `includeDirs` is optional; omit it and the plugin finds the MLIR include root itself.
- `output

Path` is optional (stdout otherwise); parent directories are created automatically.
- Returns `{ ok,
exitCode, timedOut, outputPath, generatedLines, bytes, includeDirs, includeSource, logPath, hint }`
exitCode, timedOut, outputPath, generatedLines, bytes, includeDirs, includeSource, logPath, hint }`.
**Include resolution order:** tool argument → plugin `includeDirs` → `MLIR_INCLUDE_DIR` → automatic
candidates. A candidate is used only if it actually contains `mlir/IR/OpBase.td` and is probed among
: `mlirDev.include`/`lib`/`cmakeDir` (and their parents), `<llvm.root>/include`, `<mlirRoot>/include
`, `<mlirRoot>/tools/mlir/include`, and `llvm-src/*/mlir/include` beside either root or one level up
. When nothing is found, the hint lists every directory that was searched.
### `mlir_parse_check`
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- `source` and `path` are mutually exclusive (supplying both is an error, nothing is spawned).
- `pa
sses` accepts a full pipeline string (`builtin.module(cse,canonicalize)`) or an array, which is wrap

ped automatically. It runs through `--pass-pipeline=`.
